title: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's birth chart
metaDescription: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.4° Pisces. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The chart's headline is a square: Mars and Neptune within 0.0°, drive wired to imagination. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 26.4° Pisces: the third decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Mars. A water sign, read here in its third face.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 2.0° Aries, Venus was at 28.3° Aquarius, Mars was at 9.1° Scorpio. Read together: a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste led by wit and proportion; drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Mars at right angles from Neptune, 0.0° off exact. The old texts treat a square as the aspect you feel earliest and thank latest: obstruction first, competence afterwards. Behind it, Jupiter conjunction Neptune at 0.4°, and Mars square Jupiter at 0.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mars, Uranus, Pluto close a triangle of trines. Three trines close into a circuit the tradition calls a grand trine — ease so complete it can idle unnoticed for years. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: One planet here sits in a sign the classical scheme scores. Mars in Scorpio at 9.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives water 4, fire 3, air 2, earth 1, and fixed 5, mutable 3, cardinal 2 across the modes. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. Mercury, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aquarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.8° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 16.9°.
